Kyle.fact: Kyle is brought to a chamber and restrained in a chair bolted to the floor, facing Hua and her syndicate men.
Hua names the Yuen-Pak contract, revealing that Kyle's theft from the Syndicate is the reason he has been brought here.
Hua explains the Syndicate's penalty for theft — return what was taken, then surrender something of equivalent weight — and frames the Φ85,000 Yuen-Pak payment as the measure of what Kyle owes.
Kyle tells Hua he does not have the money.
Two men seize Kyle by both wrists using a trained immobilization grip while a fourth man readies a cauterizer wand.
Kyle's hands are severed at both wrists with a ceramic-composite cleaver and the wounds are immediately cauterized.
One of the men holding Kyle looks away during the amputation, which Kyle and his hardware both register.
Kyle is dragged to a grate in the south arm and thrown into a sluice six meters below.
Kyle hits the slope and slides four meters down the incline, taking impact on his left hip, shoulder, and skull before coming to rest against the wall.
Kyle's NeoCortex runs a shock protocol, cataloguing bodily damage, rerouting systems, and flagging battery at 24% and endorphin reserves critically low.
Kyle inventories his situation and confirms he has nothing — no blade, no shotgun, only the wall, the slope, and 24% battery.
Kyle uses the wall and slope to pull himself upright incrementally, achieving a standing position.
An unidentified creature with joints that bend beyond design specification announces its presence from the east branch of the tunnel, moving closer.
Kyle places his back to the wall and chooses to stand and listen as the creature approaches rather than flee.
Kyle decides to move west and then down rather than east, choosing the maintenance hatch as his escape route.
Kyle forces open a corroded maintenance hatch in the south wall using his forearm and body mechanics.
Kyle drops two meters through the hatch onto a grating, landing in a controlled crouch.
Kyle discovers the maintenance bay is Axiom-era construction and assesses the standing water as stable, meaning the bay is sealed from active water inflow.
Kyle's NeoCortex hardware detects a salvage-tech harness on a bench via residual heat signature.
Kyle begins attempting to don or manipulate the salvage-tech harness using his knee, lacking hands to do so conventionally.
Kyle reveals that the Syndicate courier was selling cold-chain data to Arcturus, exposing a leak in Hua's operation.
Hua confronts Kyle about completing a Syndicate delivery and keeping the fee, framing it as an accounting of wrongdoing.
Kyle chooses to break his silence and reveal the courier's betrayal rather than accept punishment.
Two men pin Kyle's wrists to the chair arms while a third approaches from the left with a cleaver.
Kyle's hands are amputated with a cleaver and his wrists are cauterized.
Two guards carry Kyle through an unused door, down a corridor, and drop him through a freight grate into darkness six meters above moving water.
As the grate closes above him, Kyle registers that Silence remains upstairs under someone else's hand.

Hua.fact: Kyle is brought to a chamber and restrained in a chair bolted to the floor, facing Hua and her syndicate men.
Hua names the Yuen-Pak contract, revealing that Kyle's theft from the Syndicate is the reason he has been brought here.
Hua explains the Syndicate's penalty for theft — return what was taken, then surrender something of equivalent weight — and frames the Φ85,000 Yuen-Pak payment as the measure of what Kyle owes.
Kyle tells Hua he does not have the money.
Someone unrolls a canvas toolkit on the floor between Kyle and Hua, revealing instruments prepared before Kyle's arrival.
Hua places Kyle's severed hands palms-up into a barrel of water in a deliberate, ritualistic manner.
Kyle reveals that the Syndicate courier was selling cold-chain data to Arcturus, exposing a leak in Hua's operation.
Hua confronts Kyle about completing a Syndicate delivery and keeping the fee, framing it as an accounting of wrongdoing.
Hua goes very still in a qualitatively different way after Kyle's revelation, her certainty visibly disrupted.
Hua silently decides that the leak does not change her course of action, communicating her verdict through withdrawal of attention rather than words.
Hua carries Kyle's severed hands to a chum barrel and places them inside palms-up, leaving the lid ajar.
Hua rests her hand on Silence's saya for three deliberate seconds in full view of everyone in the room.
The protagonist recalls a witnessed gesture — Hua's thumb crossing a friction-sheath's edge over Silence on a lacquered table — as the only image his mind will organize around.

protagonist.fact: The protagonist speaks aloud into the dark, asking 'Are you helping me.'
The protagonist understands that a presence predating the facility's abandonment has been here since and has chosen to intervene in his specific crisis.
The protagonist hits a ferrocrete slope at an angle, sliding three meters with cauterizer bands dragging across the surface, causing seeping wounds at the seal edges.
The protagonist commands himself to get up despite having no hands to bear his weight.
The protagonist rolls onto his side, gets his knees under him, finds the wall with his shoulder, and walks himself upright using the ferrocrete wall.
The protagonist detects multiple creatures moving toward him in the tunnel, parsing echoes to count three or more by their wrongly-configured joint sounds.
The protagonist recalls a witnessed gesture — Hua's thumb crossing a friction-sheath's edge over Silence on a lacquered table — as the only image his mind will organize around.
The protagonist chooses to walk toward the sound of faster-moving water, reasoning it indicates a junction and a way up, ignoring the closing threat behind him.
The pursuing creatures multiply in sound behind the protagonist as he walks away, closing the distance while he refuses to look back.
The E.L.F. redirected the protagonist toward a sealed maintenance door and opened it using a specific mechanical sequence.
The E.L.F. twice steered the protagonist into side corridors and held him still to avoid an irregular patrol.
The protagonist asked the E.L.F. why it is helping him.
The E.L.F.'s status strip resolved into the salvage rights glyph, revealing its motivation is acquisition rather than alliance or help.
The protagonist chose to set aside the question of what the E.L.F. intends to collect and continue upstairs.
The E.L.F. pointed up the next flight of stairs and the protagonist followed.
The protagonist locates a freight grate twenty meters above his starting point by following the sound of rain through the ferrocrete.
The protagonist emerges through the freight grate into a rain-soaked alley and collapses to his knees on wet asphalt before the hardware forces him to stand.
The protagonist reaches the AutoDoc kiosk on the corner where the alley opens, having navigated four blocks by physical signage.
The protagonist keys the AutoDoc interface with his chin and the kiosk reads the necklace of severed hands, biometrically matching them to his cauterized stumps.
The AutoDoc's surgical arms lift the protagonist onto the table, remove the necklace and cable binding, and deliberately lay Silence on the side tray aligned exactly as Hua had arranged it.
As the anesthesia enters, the cargo arm's status strip resolves from brownout to a decommissioned Axiom glyph reading 'We are not done.'
The anesthesia compound is administered and the protagonist loses consciousness as the AutoDoc begins surgery.

unnamed man.fact: He crosses through rising water to reach the woman, stopping two meters away from her.
He tells her 'I don't have the money,' which she understands as a coded death sentence.
The E.L.F. arm raises and fires a precise shot through the woman's sternum, killing her instantly and silently.
He retrieves his severed hands from a barrel where they had been stored, finding them preserved exactly as Hua had placed them.
The E.L.F. arm threads twine through the cauterized wrists and fashions the severed hands into a necklace, which is then lowered over his head.
He nods once — not to anyone present — and turns toward the surface, departing the room.
